note: Orrery, a small planetarium, all in this file: the 3D view is the bodies projected with sin and cos in computed values and drawn as discs and paths, and each body's thumbnail is a node drawn into the image body:<id> (snapshot). The bodies strip at the bottom is Sinopia's slide sorter, installed through the bodies.dock point and orrery-sorter.adapter.json.

sky.bodies.description: Every body in the orrery, in order: id, name, the id of the body it orbits (empty for the Sun) and a thumbnail image.

bodies.reorder.description: Moves body args.id to the place of body args.onto.

bodies.clone.description: Adds a twin of body args.id on the same orbit, half a turn away.

bodies.dock.description: The strip under the timeline, across the window.
